free_tier.stated: A free test server for up to 5 days for legal entities and up to 3 days for individuals, capped at 8 CPU, 16 GB RAM and 200 GB disk, granted by a support ticket after phone confirmation.

egress.terms: The VDS page states 'Безлимитный интернет трафик' (unlimited internet traffic) with a configurable channel bandwidth; no overage price is published.

interface_detail: REST API documented at oblako.kz/rest-api (limits: 30 POST/PUT/DELETE and 1000 GET requests per 5 minutes); SSH to Linux VPS, and the web panel.
tooling: the REST API at oblako.kz/rest-api is called over plain HTTP; the page names no CLI or client library.
chaining: An 8 vCPU / 16 GiB box for three days is enough to run a benchmark or a bulk conversion and nothing that needs to persist; the value is the burst shape, not the duration.

limits.value: The test is not automatic: it requires a phone confirmation, a support ticket stating the purpose, and a support decision that the provider explicitly reserves the right to refuse without giving a reason.

limits_note: The test is not automatic: it requires a phone confirmation, a support ticket stating the purpose, and a support decision that the provider explicitly reserves the right to refuse without giving a reason.
binding_note: The test is not automatic: it requires a phone confirmation, a support ticket stating the purpose, and a support decision that the provider explicitly reserves the right to refuse without giving a reason.

evidence.proved: the help page states, in Russian, that the test period is up to 5 days for legal entities and up to 3 days for individuals, that a test server may not exceed 8 CPU, 16 GB RAM and 200 GB disk, that support staff make the final decision on the duration or on refusal, and that the provider reserves the right not to state a reason for refusal
the product page prices VPS and VDS servers in Kazakhstani tenge with hourly, daily and monthly options, across data centres in Kazakhstan, Russia and Belarus
unlimited internet traffic is stated for VDS
REST API exists with request limits
evidence.quote: 1000: максимальное количество запросов типа GET в 5 минут

evidence.proved: the provider documents an API for automating its control panel; the page names no client library or CLI
evidence.quote: Вы можете использовать API для автоматизации работы с нашей панелью управления.

notes: The constraint that matters is that it is discretionary: the provider states it may refuse without a reason, so it is not a quota a plan can rest on.
